name: Crafter / Craftax
description: Crafter is a top-down 2D open-world survival game with procedurally generated worlds, requiring agents to forage, craft tools, manage hunger/thirst/energy, build shelter, fight monsters, and explore biomes with persistent inventory and world state. Craftax is a JAX-based successor that runs orders of magnitude faster while preserving the same mechanics and adding NetHack-inspired elements. Both serve as standard benchmarks for open-ended RL, continual learning, exploration, and generalization.
typical_sota_score: ~20-30% achievement score for RL agents; LLM agents vary
reputation: Standard benchmark for open-ended RL and continual learning; Craftax enables large-scale experiments on a single GPU; widely used in embodied agent and LLM agent research.
notes: 22 hierarchical achievements covering the full survival skill tree. Procedural generation ensures unique worlds per episode. Craftax (JAX) runs ~250x faster than Crafter. Pixel and symbolic observation modes available. Natively human-playable and LLM-interfaceable.
